description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315 & other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and location details) and confirms state ownership of these properties. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
